description: Post-assignment quality flagging: contamination, handler artifacts, expert review, post-hoc plausibility assessment

functions.name: flag_contaminant
functions.description: Flag taxa disproportionately represented in control samples (lab blanks, field blanks, or positive controls)

inputs.name: input_df
inputs.description: Long-format detection data with read counts; one row per event x taxon

inputs.name: control_samples
inputs.description: Character vector of event_id values identifying control samples

inputs.name: sample_type_col
inputs.description: Column indicating event type (alternative to control_samples; use with control_types)

inputs.name: control_types
inputs.description: Values in sample_type_col that identify controls

inputs.name: event_col
inputs.description: Column identifying L1 collection events (not observation_id)

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Column with taxon names

inputs.name: reads_col
inputs.description: Column with read counts; drives depth-weighted field_rate/control_rate

inputs.name: contaminant_type
inputs.description: 2026-07-24: no longer changes output COLUMN NAMES (those are now fixed: observation_validity/validity_flag/validity_reason). Only changes the qualifier embedded in validity_flag's value, e.g. 'invalid_lab_contaminant' vs 'invalid_positive_control'

inputs.name: score_thresholds
inputs.description: Two-element vector defining invalid/questionable/valid boundaries on observation_validity

inputs.name: prior_weight
inputs.description: Empirical-Bayes shrinkage weight toward 0.5, in read-equivalent units (Session 152 -- was sample-count units through Session 151)

output.description: Per-taxon summary with fixed columns observation_validity (numeric 0-1, high = genuine), validity_flag ('valid' / 'questionable_{contaminant_type}' / 'invalid_{contaminant_type}'), validity_reason, plus informational field_rate/control_rate/n_reads_total/n_field_present/n_controls_present/n_controls_total. contaminant_type's value is embedded in validity_flag, not the column name.

functions.name: flag_handler
functions.description: Flag detections temporally proximate to handler presence (camera traps, acoustic recorders)

inputs.name: input_df
inputs.description: Detection data with datetime column

inputs.name: datetime_col
inputs.description: Column with datetime values (auto-parsed)

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Taxon column

inputs.name: group_col
inputs.description: Column for grouping (e.g., camera station); min/max computed per group

inputs.name: interval_minutes
inputs.description: Minutes before/after session edges to flag

inputs.name: handler_taxa
inputs.description: Taxa indicating handler presence (default: Homo sapiens)

inputs.name: station_metadata
inputs.description: Optional per-group deploy_time/retrieve_time table; anchors edges on real deploy/retrieve times instead of the detection data's own min/max. Requires group_col

inputs.name: deploy_col
inputs.description: Column in station_metadata with deployment timestamp

inputs.name: retrieve_col
inputs.description: Column in station_metadata with retrieval timestamp

output.description: Input with fixed columns observation_validity (numeric 0-1, high = genuine), validity_flag ('valid'/'questionable_handling'/'invalid_handling'), validity_reason, edge_anchor_source ('station_metadata' or 'detection_data_fallback') added. Same column names as flag_contaminant() (2026-07-24 unified schema)

functions.name: review_assignments
functions.description: LLM expert review of taxonomic assignments for ecological plausibility (habitat fit, geographic range, scope, contaminant risk, alternatives)

inputs.name: input_df
inputs.description: Data frame with a taxon column; typically filtered to flagged rows (suspect, unexpected, etc.)

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Column name for the taxon to review

inputs.name: taxon_rank_col
inputs.description: Column for consensus rank; triggers lower_hypotheses when coarser than species

inputs.name: plausible_taxa_col
inputs.description: Name of the list column containing per-observation plausible candidate taxa (e.g. 'plausible_taxa' from TaxaAssign::posterior_consensus()). When supplied, the LLM receives the FULL candidate set for each unique combination rather than just the upranked consensus taxon (the 'use candidates' review mode); singletons are still reviewed by species name. NULL (default): dedupes on taxon_col only

inputs.name: irreducible_only
inputs.description: When plausible_taxa_col is supplied and an irreducible_consensus column is present in input_df (added by TaxaAssign::add_slash_taxon()), only candidate sets where irreducible_consensus==TRUE are reviewed; non-irreducible rows get NA review columns. Ignored when plausible_taxa_col=NULL

inputs.name: consensus_posterior_col
inputs.description: Column for TaxaAssign::posterior_consensus()'s consensus_posterior -- the pipeline's own statistical confidence in the winning taxon, shown to the LLM as median context per label. Purely additive text; silently skipped when absent. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: winner_prior_col
inputs.description: Column for posterior_consensus()'s winner_prior (the occurrence-database prior for the winning taxon), shown as median context (e.g. 'occurrence prior=0.42'). Silently skipped when absent. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: winner_rank_expanded_col
inputs.description: Column for posterior_consensus()'s winner_rank_expanded (TRUE when the winning species-level call was manufactured by join_priors()'s coarse-rank expansion from occurrence-prior mass alone, with no direct sequence/image/acoustic evidence discriminating candidates). Adds a note to the LLM context when TRUE. Silently skipped when absent. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: plausible_posteriors_col
inputs.description: Column for posterior_consensus()'s plausible_posteriors list column (per-candidate posterior weights, aligned with plausible_taxa_col). Only used when plausible_taxa_col is supplied; averaged across rows sharing a label and shown to the LLM (e.g. candidate weights per species). Silently skipped when absent

inputs.name: consensus_plausibility_col
inputs.description: Column for add_posthoc_assessment()'s consensus_plausibility -- specifically its 'unprecedented' value (no local occurrence record at all, a pipeline-computed fact). Shown to the LLM as 'pipeline flags UNPRECEDENTED: ...' and gates the consensus-scope skepticism GUIDELINES bullet plus the deterministic geographic_disagreement_basis output column. Silently skipped when absent. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: consensus_discrimination_col
inputs.description: Column for add_posthoc_assessment()'s consensus_discrimination -- specifically its 'indistinguishable' value (a one-sided tail probability says a confusable relative could score just as well). Same skepticism-gate treatment as consensus_plausibility_col. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: dist_nearest_occupied_km_col
inputs.description: Column for TaxaFlag::check_gbif_tile_range()'s dist_nearest_occupied_km -- distance from the study site to the nearest GBIF-mapped occurrence of the taxon worldwide. Shown as median context alongside patch_diameter_km_col. Silently skipped when absent. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: patch_diameter_km_col
inputs.description: Column for check_gbif_tile_range()'s patch_diameter_km, shown alongside dist_nearest_occupied_km_col as a rough size for the occupied area found. Silently skipped when absent or when dist_nearest_occupied_km_col is not shown. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: beyond_buffer_col
inputs.description: Column for check_gbif_tile_range()'s beyond_buffer -- when TRUE, shown instead of distance/patch as 'GBIF: no occurrence found anywhere globally'. Silently skipped when absent. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: inat_in_range_col
inputs.description: Column for TaxaFetch::check_inat_range()'s in_range. Shown as 'in range'/'outside range' alongside inat_n_observations_col/inat_matched_name_col when present. Silently skipped when absent. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: inat_n_observations_col
inputs.description: Column for check_inat_range()'s n_observations. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: inat_matched_name_col
inputs.description: Column for check_inat_range()'s matched_name -- the taxon iNaturalist's own name search actually resolved the query to. When it differs from the taxon under review, flagged in the prompt as a plain factual annotation. Set NULL to disable

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Named list or build_context() output with geography/ecoregion and habitat/main_habitat

inputs.name: target_group
inputs.description: Taxonomic target group (e.g., 'fish', 'birds'); triggers scope review

inputs.name: marker
inputs.description: Molecular marker or detection method (e.g., '12S', 'COI', 'camera trap')

inputs.name: data_type
inputs.description: 'eDNA', 'acoustic', or 'image' — switches contaminant guidance in the LLM prompt

inputs.name: llm_fn
inputs.description: LLM provider function. Use TaxaTools::call_api (auto-selects provider). Valid names: call_api, call_anthropic_api, call_gemini_api, call_openai_api, call_azure_api, call_ollama_api. Do NOT invent other names.

inputs.name: taxa_per_call
inputs.description: Maximum taxa (or candidate sets) per LLM batch call (default 15 to avoid response truncation; candidate-set entries are longer than single taxon names, consider 8-10 with plausible_taxa_col)

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Maximum response tokens requested from llm_fn. NULL (default) does not pass max_tokens at all, so llm_fn's own default applies (3000L for TaxaTools::call_api()). Raise this if max_retries alone isn't resolving truncation warnings

inputs.name: max_retries
inputs.description: When a batch's LLM response is truncated, empty, or unparseable, the batch is automatically split in half and retried up to this many times before falling back to NA defaults for whatever's still missing. Does not apply to a hard llm_fn error

inputs.name: pause_seconds
inputs.description: Seconds between LLM calls

inputs.name: cache_dir
inputs.description: Directory for a per-taxon review cache. NULL (default) disables caching entirely (the historical behaviour). Supplying a directory makes a re-run REPRODUCIBLE and stops it re-paying for verdicts already obtained -- the review is a judgement, and two runs 50 minutes apart on identical input can disagree. Keyed on the taxon label/rank, its attached pipeline/weight/spatial notes, context, target_group, marker, data_type, and the candidate-set path. Manage with taxaflag_clear_cache()

inputs.name: verbose
inputs.description: Print progress messages

output.description: Input df with 8 or 9 review columns (llm_ prefixed since 2026-09-06 -- independent LLM judgments, never derived from the pipeline's own values): llm_habitat_plausibility, llm_geographic_plausibility, llm_scope_plausibility, llm_contamination_risk, review_alternatives, review_lower_hypotheses, review_confidence, review_comment. Also adds geographic_disagreement_basis (character, NA unless the LLM rated llm_geographic_plausibility likely/possible despite the pipeline flagging the taxon unprecedented (via consensus_plausibility_col) and/or indistinguishable (via consensus_discrimination_col) -- deterministic, code-computed, not an LLM output).

functions.scaling_note: LLM calls; batched at taxa_per_call, ~1 min per 15 taxa. Cached calls (cache_dir supplied) make zero new LLM calls for unchanged input

functions.name: add_posthoc_assessment
functions.description: Append two independent diagnostic axes to a posterior_consensus() output, reported for primary_taxon and consensus_taxon separately: occurrence plausibility (Axis 1 -- primary_plausibility/consensus_plausibility, 'how expected is this taxon here?') and discrimination (Axis 2 -- primary_discrimination/consensus_discrimination, 'could the evidence tell this taxon apart from a plausible relative?'). Neither axis gates or overrides the other. Redesigned 2026-07-30 -- superseded the old single posthoc_assessment column (tiers/taxon_col/tier_col/finest_rank all removed).

inputs.name: consensus_df
inputs.description: Output of TaxaAssign::posterior_consensus(), containing at minimum winner_likelihood_col, consensus_taxon_col, and consensus_rank_col

inputs.name: winner_likelihood_col
inputs.description: Column holding the winner's ratio-normalised likelihood; used only by the domestic-species caveat

inputs.name: consensus_taxon_col
inputs.description: Column holding the consensus taxon name; used only by the domestic-species caveat

inputs.name: consensus_rank_col
inputs.description: Column holding the consensus rank; drives which expected_theta_threshold entry consensus_plausibility compares against

inputs.name: likelihood_threshold
inputs.description: Likelihood cutoff the domestic-species caveat uses for 'the ID itself is trustworthy'; unused when domestic_taxa is NULL

inputs.name: domestic_taxa
inputs.description: Taxon names (matched against consensus_taxon_col) that are domestic/synanthropic for your study system; NULL disables the domestic-prior-caveat feature entirely (no built-in default list)

inputs.name: domestic_prior_source
inputs.description: 'wild' (raw GBIF/iNat occurrence prior, no domestic augmentation -- flag fires) or 'augmented' (prior pipeline already incorporated known local domestic presence -- flag never fires); ignored when domestic_taxa is NULL

inputs.name: primary_confusion_risk_col
inputs.description: Column holding posterior_consensus()'s winner_own_rank_confusion_risk (rank-matched to primary_taxon); drives primary_discrimination

inputs.name: consensus_confusion_risk_col
inputs.description: Column holding the confusion-risk value rank-matched to consensus_taxon; drives consensus_discrimination

inputs.name: discriminating_threshold
inputs.description: Below this confusion-risk value, the resolved rank is 'discriminating'

inputs.name: indistinguishable_threshold
inputs.description: At or above this confusion-risk value, the resolved rank is 'indistinguishable'; between the two thresholds, 'weak'

inputs.name: winner_theta_col
inputs.description: Column holding the winning hypothesis's own raw occurrence-model share (from posterior_consensus()); drives primary_plausibility. Deliberately theta_mean, NOT winner_prior/prior_mean (which can be inflated by update_prior_from_consensus()'s confirmation boost)

inputs.name: winner_record_col
inputs.description: Column indicating whether the winning hypothesis's taxon carries a real occurrence record at all; this (not a low theta value) is what makes a call 'unprecedented'

inputs.name: consensus_prior_col
inputs.description: Column holding the occurrence-model share (theta_mean-based group sum) for the consensus taxon

inputs.name: consensus_record_col
inputs.description: Column indicating whether the consensus taxon's group carries a real occurrence record at all; this (not consensus_prior_col's NA-ness) is what makes a call 'unprecedented' at consensus scope

inputs.name: expected_theta_threshold
inputs.description: No safe universal default -- names must be rank labels (e.g. c(species=0.008, genus=0.02, family=0.05)); 'species' is required since primary_plausibility always compares against it. Recommended: median theta_sum at each rank from TaxaAssign::compute_group_priors() (species: median(taxaexpect_priors$theta_mean, na.rm=TRUE) directly)

output.description: Input with 5 columns appended: primary_plausibility/consensus_plausibility ('expected'/'unexpected'/'unprecedented'/'not_modeled'), primary_discrimination/consensus_discrimination ('discriminating'/'weak'/'indistinguishable'/'not_modeled'), and domestic_prior_caveat (logical)

functions.scaling_note: Fast; vectorised lookup — runs on full consensus_df before filtering for review

functions.name: flag_watch_candidates
functions.description: The likelihood-side surveillance guarantee for watch-list species: flags an observation where a watch-list species' raw match score ties or beats the consensus winner's own best match score. Prior-free and purely informational -- never edits consensus columns.

inputs.name: consensus_df
inputs.description: One row per observation -- TaxaAssign::posterior_consensus() output (or anything carrying observation_col and winner_col)

inputs.name: match_df
inputs.description: Data frame of raw match candidates (e.g. the workflow's match_obj_restored) carrying observation_col, taxon_col, and score_col

inputs.name: watch_taxa
inputs.description: Watch-list species names (e.g. an invasive-species list)

inputs.name: observation_col
inputs.description: Observation identifier column shared by both inputs

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Candidate taxon-name column in match_df

inputs.name: score_col
inputs.description: Raw match-score column in match_df (higher = better)

inputs.name: winner_col
inputs.description: Winner column in consensus_df (the top-posterior candidate, present even when the final consensus upranked to a coarser rank)

inputs.name: score_margin
inputs.description: Flag when the best watch score is within this many score units of the reference score (0 = must tie or exceed)

output.description: consensus_df with four added columns: watch_flag (logical, TRUE when a watch-list species scored within score_margin of the winner's own best score), watch_taxon (best-scoring watch-list species, NA if none), watch_score (its best raw score, NA likewise), watch_reference_score (the reference score used -- winner's own best match, or best non-watch score)

functions.name: build_review_covariates
functions.description: Collapses a long-format reads table (one row per taxon x sample) to one row per observation, joined to a categorical classification column (e.g. add_posthoc_assessment()'s primary_plausibility, or a review_assignments() output column), producing covariates for modelling what predicts a review classification.

inputs.name: reads_df
inputs.description: Long-format data frame: one row per taxon x sample, with a taxon identifier, a sample/event identifier, a read-count column, and (optionally) a sequence column. Matches flag_contaminant()'s input shape

inputs.name: classification_df
inputs.description: Data frame with a taxon identifier and a classification column to be modelled -- typically add_posthoc_assessment()'s output or a review_assignments() output column

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Taxon/observation identifier column in reads_df

inputs.name: classification_taxon_col
inputs.description: Taxon/observation identifier column in classification_df (this ecosystem's consensus/review tables use a different id-column name than its read-count tables by convention)

inputs.name: classification_col
inputs.description: Column in classification_df holding the categorical label to model

inputs.name: event_col
inputs.description: Sample/event identifier column in reads_df

inputs.name: reads_col
inputs.description: Read-count column in reads_df

inputs.name: sequence_col
inputs.description: Sequence column in reads_df, used to derive seq_length. Set NULL to skip

inputs.name: control_samples
inputs.description: event_col values that are blanks/controls (same convention as flag_contaminant()); excludes blanks ONLY from the field-side read-depth covariates, not from contaminant-frequency (that comes from contaminant_df)

inputs.name: contaminant_df
inputs.description: Output of flag_contaminant(), joined in to supply blank-frequency covariates. NULL omits these columns entirely

inputs.name: contaminant_taxon_col
inputs.description: Taxon identifier column in contaminant_df; defaults to taxon_col's own value

inputs.name: contaminant_cols
inputs.description: Columns from contaminant_df to join onto the result

inputs.name: extra_covariate_cols
inputs.description: Additional columns to carry through unchanged from classification_df (e.g. 'winner_likelihood', 'consensus_rank') -- read-count-independent covariates already present there

inputs.name: read_quantile
inputs.description: Quantile (0,1] of per-sample field read counts used for quantile_reads (a less extreme-value-sensitive alternative to max_reads); 1 reproduces max_reads

output.description: One row per classification_df row: observation_id, classification, seq_length (omitted if sequence_col=NULL), min_reads, max_reads, quantile_reads, total_reads, n_samples_detected, prop_samples_detected, plus contaminant_df columns when supplied

functions.name: check_gbif_tile_range
functions.description: Spatial-isolation signal for a taxon from GBIF's occurrence-density map tiles: downloads the GBIF density PNG tile(s) covering a query point and a buffer, and reports how isolated the point is from the taxon's known range (occupied cell? nearest occupied cell distance? patch size?).

inputs.name: taxon_key
inputs.description: GBIF backbone usageKey for the taxon (resolve via TaxaFetch::get_keys_from_context() or rgbif::name_backbone())

inputs.name: query_lat
inputs.description: The point to check. Must be within Web Mercator's valid range (approx -85.05 to 85.05)

inputs.name: query_lon
inputs.description: The point to check (longitude)

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.description: Starting tile zoom level in [0,12]. Controls the real-world size of each density cell and how much ground a fixed buffer_px covers. 6 is roughly continental scale

inputs.name: buffer_px
inputs.description: How far around the query point to scan for the nearest occupied cell, in tile pixels; rounded up to the nearest multiple of 512

inputs.name: escalate
inputs.description: Widen the search to coarser zoom levels when nothing is found at zoom

inputs.name: min_zoom
inputs.description: Coarsest zoom level escalation is allowed to reach in [0, zoom]. 0 means the whole world (one tile). Ignored when escalate=FALSE

inputs.name: base_url
inputs.description: GBIF map tile base URL. Exposed for testing

output.description: One-row data frame: taxon_key, query_lat, query_lon, zoom_requested, zoom_used (NA if nothing found anywhere), escalated (logical), tile_size, n_tiles_fetched, resolution_km_per_px, point_occupied (logical), dist_nearest_occupied_km, patch_size_px, patch_size_capped (logical, a lower bound if TRUE), patch_area_km2, patch_diameter_km, beyond_buffer (logical -- TRUE means no occupied cell found anywhere in the escalation range, a real global-absence finding when escalate=TRUE with default min_zoom=0)

functions.scaling_note: A few GBIF tile downloads per call (more if escalation runs); fast, no auth needed

functions.name: compute_local_occurrence_distance
functions.description: For each taxon in taxon_names, finds the nearest record of that taxon already present in occurrence_data (data already fetched for this study -- no new network call) and reports the geodesic distance from query_lat/query_lon to it.

inputs.name: taxon_names
inputs.description: One or more taxon names to check (e.g. every consensus_taxon flagged 'unexpected'/'unprecedented'). Matched exactly against occurrence_data[[taxon_col]]

inputs.name: query_lat
inputs.description: The point to measure distance from -- typically the study site's own centroid

inputs.name: query_lon
inputs.description: The point to measure distance from (longitude)

inputs.name: occurrence_data
inputs.description: Data frame of already-fetched occurrence records (e.g. all_occurrences, occurrences_clean). Must contain taxon_col, lat_col, lon_col

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Column name in occurrence_data

inputs.name: lat_col
inputs.description: Column name in occurrence_data (DarwinCore convention)

inputs.name: lon_col
inputs.description: Column name in occurrence_data (DarwinCore convention)

inputs.name: date_col
inputs.description: Optional column in occurrence_data giving the nearest record's collection date/year (e.g. GBIF's own 'year' column). When supplied and present, surfaces nearest_date on the matched record. NULL (default): no age column requested, fully backward compatible

output.description: One row per unique entry in taxon_names: taxon_name, n_local_records (0 for a taxon with no local record -- the answer, not a failure), dist_nearest_km (NA if n_local_records=0), nearest_lat, nearest_lon, nearest_date (only present when date_col supplied and found)

functions.scaling_note: Fast; free -- reuses already-fetched occurrence_data, no new network call

functions.name: review_spatial_context
functions.description: Opens a Shiny gadget for scrolling through consensus taxa (grouped by plausibility) with an interactive GBIF density-tile map, local occurrence-distance panel, iNaturalist range/point context, and an opt-in 'Run AI Review' button (review_assignments()). Interactive gadget only -- no non-graph representation needed beyond metadata.

inputs.name: input_df
inputs.description: Data frame of consensus taxa (e.g. consensus_final after add_posthoc_assessment()). Must contain taxon_col; supply plausibility_col=NULL if there's no grouping column

inputs.name: query_lat
inputs.description: The study site to check distances/tiles against

inputs.name: query_lon
inputs.description: The study site to check distances/tiles against (longitude)

inputs.name: taxon_col
inputs.description: Column in input_df naming each taxon

inputs.name: plausibility_col
inputs.description: Column in input_df used to group the taxon dropdown. NULL shows every taxon in one unfiltered list

inputs.name: occurrence_data
inputs.description: Already-fetched occurrence records this study kept (e.g. occurrences_clean); passed to compute_local_occurrence_distance() and overlaid on the map. NULL (default) omits the free/local panel and point overlay

inputs.name: excluded_occurrence_data
inputs.description: Occurrence records this study's own GBIF quality/outlier/institution/spatial-QC filtering excluded, same shape as occurrence_data -- overlaid as hollow red rings for provenance. NULL (default) omits this overlay

inputs.name: occurrence_taxon_col
inputs.description: Column shared by occurrence_data AND excluded_occurrence_data

inputs.name: occurrence_lat_col
inputs.description: Column shared by occurrence_data AND excluded_occurrence_data

inputs.name: occurrence_lon_col
inputs.description: Column shared by occurrence_data AND excluded_occurrence_data

inputs.name: inat_range
inputs.description: Pre-computed TaxaFetch::check_inat_range() output (one row per taxon), checked FIRST for free before any live call. Typically only computed for a pipeline's undetected/unreferenced candidate list, not every taxon -- see live_inat_check

inputs.name: inat_taxon_col
inputs.description: Taxon-name column in inat_range

inputs.name: live_inat_check
inputs.description: When a taxon has no row in inat_range (including inat_range=NULL), falls back to a real, live TaxaFetch::check_inat_range() call for just that taxon. Free (no LLM billing), fires automatically on selection. Requires TaxaFetch and a real INAT_API_TOKEN; silently falls back to 'no data' when unavailable

inputs.name: inat_cache_dir
inputs.description: Forwarded to check_inat_range()'s own cache_dir when live_inat_check fires. NULL (default) disables caching

inputs.name: inat_radius_km
inputs.description: Search radius (km) for the real iNaturalist observation points plotted on the map -- distinct from live_inat_check's range-polygon check. A dashed circle of this radius is drawn on the map

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Passed straight to review_assignments() when 'Run AI Review' is clicked. Defaulting to NULL (rather than required) is what hides the button entirely -- supply it to enable on-demand AI review

inputs.name: target_group
inputs.description: Passed straight to review_assignments() when 'Run AI Review' is clicked

inputs.name: marker
inputs.description: Passed straight to review_assignments() when 'Run AI Review' is clicked

inputs.name: llm_fn
inputs.description: Passed straight to review_assignments() when 'Run AI Review' is clicked

inputs.name: tile
inputs.description: Leaflet base-map tile provider -- muted/mostly-grayscale so GBIF's own density colours stand out

inputs.name: gbif_style
inputs.description: GBIF map API style query parameter. A bare '.point' style is auto-upgraded to its '.poly' counterpart and combined with gbif_bin_size unless it's a Heat-family style

inputs.name: gbif_bin_size
inputs.description: GBIF map API bin=square/squareSize binning, aggregating raw single-pixel occurrence dots into visibly larger squares. Silently a no-op unless style is switched to .poly (handled automatically via gbif_style). NULL disables binning entirely

inputs.name: gbif_year_range
inputs.description: GBIF map API year query parameter (e.g. '1995,2025'), display-only -- affects only the visual tile layer, NOT check_gbif_tile_range()'s own distance/patch numbers (which stay all-time/global). NULL (default) shows GBIF's full all-time record

output.description: NULL invisibly. The gadget is for interactive exploration only

functions.scaling_note: Interactive; GBIF tile fetches and optional live iNat checks per taxon selected. LLM review only when 'Run AI Review' is clicked

functions.name: report_flags
functions.description: Generate a Report Section for Quality Flagging

inputs.name: flagged_data
inputs.description: Data frame. Assignment data with flag columns from flag_contaminant, flag_handler, and/or review_assignments.

inputs.name: verbose
inputs.description: Logical. Print summary messages. Default FALSE.

functions.name: taxaflag_clear_cache
functions.description: Report and clear TaxaFlag's on-disk caches

inputs.name: cache_dir
inputs.description: Character. The directory passed to review_assignments()'s or check_gbif_tile_range()'s cache_dir (each function's cache lives in its own directory, so point this at whichever one you want to inspect/clear). Defaults to tools::R_user_dir("TaxaFlag", "cache"), matching the sibling packages; workflows

inputs.name: older_than_days
inputs.description: Optional numeric. Delete only entries older than this many days. NULL (default) considers every entry.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Logical. TRUE reports what would be deleted without deleting it.
